def f(g):
    from collections import deque
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    vis=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    dq=deque((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if (i in(0,h-1) or j in(0,w-1)) and g[i][j]==bg)
    vis=[[g[i][j]==bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if (i in(0,h-1) or j in(0,w-1)) and g[i][j]==bg: vis[i][j]=True
    while dq:
        i,j=dq.popleft()
        for a,b in((i+1,j),(i-1,j),(i,j+1),(i,j-1)):
            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and not vis[a][b] and g[a][b]==bg:
                vis[a][b]=True; dq.append((a,b))
    return [[4 if not vis[i][j] and g[i][j]==bg else g[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
